paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.54% on average, with Nikkei 225 strongest (+0.84%) and Euro Stoxx 50 weakest (-1.82%). Brent crude changed -2.92% to 91.85. Gold changed +1.70% to 3,595.8999. Bitcoin changed +0.35% to 60,589.4609. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.848%, a relative move of -1.14%. Among the firms tracked, Vale (+4.70%) and Gold Miners (ETF) (+3.53%) moved the most.
